definitions.explanation: A naturally elevated area of land. Often mentioned in the context of scenic views, residential areas, or evacuation sites during disasters.

examples.japanese: {高台|たかだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧。
examples.english: Look down on the town from the hilltop.
Houses built on elevated ground have good views.

examples.japanese: ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{高台|たかだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}して→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a tsunami warning is issued, evacuate to high ground immediately.

notes:
Frequently appears in disaster preparedness contexts, especially for tsunami evacuation. After the 2011 {東日本|ひがしにほん}{大震災|だいしんさい}, {高台|たかだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (evacuate to high ground) became widely known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高台|たかだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}する→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧ (evacuate to high ground)
- {高台|たかだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧ (built on elevated ground)
- {高台|たかだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧ (look down from high ground)
- {高台|たかだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住宅地|じゅうたくち}→住宅地：10158_juutakuchi⟧ (residential area on high ground)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧ refers to a hill as a landform
- {高台|たかだい} emphasizes the elevated position relative to surroundings
